# VLCKit / libVLC notice

Playbox uses the VLCKitSPM package for local torrent playback.

- Package: https://github.com/JustFoxLabs/vlckit-spm
- Version: 4.0.0-alpha.24-fox.1
- VLCKit/libVLC license: LGPL-2.1-or-later
- Corresponding modified VLCKit source:
  https://code.videolan.org/JustFox/VLCKit/-/tree/827ebdda348548a956ec4d9c22b2169457720219
- Corresponding modified libVLC source:
  https://code.videolan.org/JustFox/vlc/-/tree/52e28931920cc5dc3ba2d1a9774e30aa06f7a9a3

The package distributes VLCKit as a dynamic framework and publishes the corresponding modified source.
